meta.scope: UK-focused exit benchmarks for a 10-100 person product-led consultancy / small SaaS: IT services multiples, SaaS ARR multiples, EOT and BADR rules, comparable SI acquisitions
meta.grading: A = primary/official or data-provider source read directly; B = reputable secondary (advisor blog, trade press) read directly; C = inferred/derived
caveats: Equiteq, Hampleton, Cavendish, BDO, Grant Thornton, ICAEW and Beauhurst reports are gated PDFs; their headline multiples could not be read directly in this pass and are not included.
MarktoMarket publishes only an all-sector 'All-Cap' median (deals under GBP 250m) on its public pages; sector (TMT) multiples are in the paid executive report.
Aventis Advisors IT-services and SaaS multiples are global M&A medians (with Europe and deal-size cuts), not UK-only.
Public SaaS index medians (Clouded Judgement) are EV / NTM revenue for US-listed cloud companies; small private UK SaaS typically trades at a large discount to these.

eot.cgt_relief: Sale of a controlling interest to a qualifying Employee Ownership Trust: 100% CGT exemption for disposals before 26 Nov 2025; reduced to 50% of the gain exempt for disposals on or after 26 November 2025 (Autumn Budget 2025). Remaining 50% taxed at the main CGT rate (24% higher rate), giving an effective ~12% on the whole gain. BADR / Investors' Relief cannot be claimed on the taxable half.
conditions: Company must be a trading company or principal company of a trading group
EOT must acquire and retain a controlling interest: >50% of ordinary share capital, voting power and rights to profits/assets

All-employee benefit requirement: trust must benefit all eligible employees on the same terms (equality requirement; can vary by remuneration, hours, length of service); 5%+ shareholders and connected persons excluded from benefit
Limited participation: number of continuing 5%+ shareholders who are employees/directors must not exceed 2/5 of total employees
Finance Act 2025 (announced 30 Oct 2024 Budget): trustees must be UK resident; former owners and persons connected with them cannot form a majority of the trustee board (independence requirement)
Finance Act 2025: trustees must take reasonable steps to ensure the price paid does not exceed market value (and interest on deferred consideration must not exceed a reasonable commercial rate)

Finance Act 2025: clawback extended - a disqualifying event before the end of the fourth tax year following the tax year of disposal reverses the vendor's relief (previously the end of the following tax year)
Vendors must claim the relief in their return and provide additional information (number of employees, consideration, etc.)
Income-tax-free bonuses of up to GBP 3,600 per employee per year remain available to EOT-owned companies
eot.loan_note_norms: Typically the EOT pays a modest initial cash amount (often funded by the company's surplus cash and/or bank debt) and the balance as deferred consideration / vendor loan notes, fixed at completion and repaid out of post-tax profits contributed by the company to the trust over several years (commonly 3-8 years). Loan notes may carry interest at a commercial rate (now capped at a reasonable commercial rate by FA 2025). CGT can be paid as instalments are received where the statutory instalment rules apply (up to 8 years). Founders therefore carry company performance risk; sale price is normally at a discount to third-party trade value because it is funded from the company's own cash flows.
eot.badr_rate_2026: 18% from 6 April 2026 (was 10% to 5 April 2025, 14% from 6 April 2025). Main CGT rates 18% basic / 24% higher, so BADR benefit from April 2026 is 6 points, max saving GBP 60,000.
eot.badr_lifetime_limit: GBP 1,000,000 lifetime limit of qualifying gains (unchanged). Conditions: at least 5% of ordinary shares/votes and 5% of profits or proceeds, officer or employee, trading company, all for 2 years to disposal.
